screen.online.title: Online answers
screen.online.setup.title: Set up Online answers
online.row.label: Online answers
online.row.hint: Answers written by an online service you choose
online.error: Nocturne couldn’t open this. What you kept is safe.
online.unavailable: Online answers aren’t available here. What you kept is safe.
online.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing was changed.
online.checking.body: Nocturne is checking a connection. Nothing is turned on yet.
online.off.lead: Have your answers written by an online service you choose. Nocturne still finds what you kept on this computer, and only sends what each answer needs.
online.off.view.title: Always in view
online.off.view.body: Every answer says where it was written, and you can see exactly what was sent.
online.off.status: It’s off. Nothing is sent, and no service is connected, until you set it up.
online.off.history: What was sent before stays listed for 90 days.
online.off.setUpHint: You’ll need an account with an online service.
online.stays.heading: Always stays here
online.stays.keeping: Keeping, reading and the overnight tidy
online.stays.page: Your morning page and its voice
online.stays.sensitive: Health, money and ID details stay here unless you choose otherwise. Nocturne can miss some, so mark anything you never want sent as private.
online.before.lead: Questions are answered on this computer.
online.before.hint: The service you chose is still set up, so turning on takes one step.
online.before.sent.last: Last sent {when}. Nothing has been sent since you turned it off.
online.lastOn.label: Last on
online.on.lead: While this is on, your questions leave this computer. Everything else stays here.
online.provider.name: your provider ({host})
online.provider.kept: The key is kept on this computer.
online.provider.engine: Nocturne’s engine on this computer sends each question straight to this address.
online.turnOffForget: Turn off and forget the key…
online.limit.paused.title: Paused by your limit
online.limit.paused.body: You’ve asked {count, plural, one {# online question} other {# online questions}} this month. Questions are answered on this computer until {day}.
online.refused.title: your provider refused the key
online.refused.body: {host} no longer accepts the key Nocturne has. Until you check it, questions are answered on this computer.
online.noCredit.title: your provider says there’s no credit left
online.noCredit.body: Add credit on your provider’s website, then check again. Until then, questions are answered on this computer.
online.problem.title: Online answers aren’t working right now
online.problem.unreachable: {host} hasn’t answered since {time}. Questions are answered on this computer, and Nocturne tries again with your next question.
online.problem.noInternet: This computer can’t reach {host} because it isn’t connected to the internet. Questions are answered on this computer, and Nocturne tries again with your next question.
online.problem.modelMissing.title: The name to use wasn’t accepted
online.problem.modelMissing.body: {host} doesn’t know the name Nocturne has saved for what to use. Questions are answered on this computer until you check it.
online.problem.keyUnavailable.title: Nocturne can’t read the saved key
online.problem.keyUnavailable.body: The key for {host} can’t be opened on this computer. Questions are answered on this computer until you check it.
online.row.phones.label: Questions from your phones
online.row.phones.hint: Your phones show where each answer was written.
online.row.sensitive.label: Health, money and ID details
online.row.sensitive.off: Off: they stay on this computer, even when they’d help an answer.
online.row.sensitive.on: On: these lines may go with a question they help answer.
online.row.private.label: Private things
online.row.private.hint: Things you marked private stay on this computer.
online.row.limit.label: Monthly limit
online.row.limit.hint: Then questions are answered here until the 1st.
online.month.heading: This month
online.month.of: Of your limit of {limit}. Resets on {day}.
online.month.all: All {limit} of your limit. Back online on {day}.
online.month.nolimit: No limit is set. Resets on {day}.
online.month.notTold.note: your provider doesn’t tell Nocturne what each question costs. Its website shows what you’ve spent.
online.month.usd.note: As your provider reports it, in US dollars. Resets on {day}.
online.month.noBalance: Nocturne doesn’t ask your provider how much credit is left, so nothing is sent just to show this page.
online.sent.heading: Sent for online answers
online.sent.counted: Counted by Nocturne, question by question.
online.forget.title: Turn off and forget the key?
online.forget.body: Online answers turn off, and Nocturne removes the key for your provider ({host}) from this computer. To turn them on again, you’ll paste a key again.
online.forget.bodyOff: Nocturne removes the key for your provider ({host}) from this computer. To turn online answers on again, you’ll paste a key again.
online.forget.stillWorks: The key still works on your provider’s website until you delete it there. Do that too if you won’t use it again.
online.forget.history: What was sent stays listed for 90 days, unless you delete everything.
online.toast.off: Online answers are off. Questions will be answered on this computer again.
online.toast.forgot: Turned off, and the key is forgotten on this computer.
online.toast.forgotOff: The key is forgotten on this computer.
online.bar.line: Nothing is turned on until the last step.
online.explain.title: Have your answers written by an online service you choose.
online.explain.short.sent.label: Sent
online.explain.short.sent.body: Your question, with a few short lines from what you kept that help answer it.
online.explain.short.never.label: Never sent
online.explain.short.never.body: Your photos, recordings and documents themselves, and anything you marked private.
online.explain.short.needs.label: You need
online.explain.short.needs.body: An account with that service. Most charge a little for each question. Setting up means copying three details from its website.
online.explain.more: Everything that is sent, and what stays here
online.explain.changes.label: What changes
online.explain.changes.body: Your questions are answered online by the service you set up. Answers may take a few seconds longer.
online.explain.sent.label: What is sent
online.explain.sent.body: Your question, and the few things you kept that answer it, as short sentences.
online.explain.never.label: Never sent
online.explain.never.body: Photos, recordings and documents stay here. Things you marked private are never sent. Nocturne also keeps back lines that look like health, money or ID details unless you choose otherwise. It can miss some, so mark anything you never want sent as private.
online.explain.sees.label: Who sees it
online.explain.sees.body: The service you choose can see each question and what goes with it. Every answer says it was written there.
online.explain.costs.label: What it costs
online.explain.costs.body: Most services charge a little for each question, on your account with them. You choose how many questions a month may go online.
online.explain.needs.label: What you need
online.explain.needs.body: An account with an online service. You add its details in step 2, and Nocturne checks that they work.
online.explain.aside.heading: Stays on this computer
online.explain.aside.tidy: The overnight tidy and your page
online.explain.aside.receipts: Checking where each answer came from
online.explain.aside.fallback: If the service can’t be reached, this computer answers, and says so.
online.explain.aside.off: Turn it off at any time in {settings} or {privacy}.
online.example.intro: For example, if you ask about your eye test, this is all that leaves:
online.example.question: Your question
online.example.kept: What you kept that answers it
online.example.line1: The eye test with Dr Patel is on Friday 20 November at 11:20 in room 12. (kept Monday 9 November)
online.example.line2: Dr Patel will send the eye test results by 27 November. (kept Monday 9 November)
online.example.instructions: And Nocturne’s standard instructions, the same for everyone: answer only from these lines, and say which line each part came from.
online.example.instructionsShort: And Nocturne’s standard instructions, the same for everyone.
online.example.notSent: Not sent: the clinic’s letter, your voice note, your name, or anything else you kept.
online.service.title: Choose the online service.
online.service.lead: Nocturne needs to know which service writes your answers. Its details are added under Advanced details, where Nocturne also checks that they work.
online.service.where: Later, find it in {settings}, then {showAdvancedDetails}, then {connectOnlineService}.
online.service.ready: Connected to {host}. To use a different service, open Advanced details.
online.service.aside.heading: Why Advanced details?
online.service.aside.apart: These details come from the service’s own website, so they are kept apart from the plain steps.
online.service.aside.check: Nocturne sends one short test question to check them. Nothing you kept goes with it, and nothing is turned on until the last step.
online.send.title: Choose which questions may go online.
online.send.lead: Nocturne only sends what each answer needs. You can change these later in {settings}, under {onlineAnswers}.
online.send.here.label: Questions on this computer
online.send.here.hint: The ones you type or say here. You can still answer one here instead, each time you ask.
online.send.phones.label: Questions from your phones
online.send.phones.hint: Your phones show where each answer was written. Turn off to keep phone questions on this computer.
online.send.sensitive.label: Health, money and ID details
online.send.sensitive.hint: Nocturne keeps a line here when it is about health or medicine, or holds what looks like a card or bank number, a long number, a passport or ID number, a password or PIN, or an amount you earn or owe. It can miss some, so mark anything else private. Turn on to let those lines go with a question they help answer.
online.send.private.label: Private things are never sent
online.send.private.hint: Things you marked private stay on this computer, whatever you choose here.
online.send.aside.heading: What goes with a question
online.send.aside.body: The question, and at most 12 short lines you kept that answer it, each with the day you kept it.
online.send.aside.first: Nocturne finds those lines on this computer first. The service never sees the rest.
online.limit.title: Set a monthly limit.
online.limit.count: Most services charge a little for each question. The service you chose, {host}, doesn’t tell Nocturne what each one costs, so the limit counts questions.
online.limit.money: The service you chose, {host}, tells Nocturne what each question costs, so you can set the limit in money.
online.limit.amount.label: Amount in US dollars
online.limit.usdNote: In US dollars, as your provider reports it.
online.limit.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 upwards, like 200.
online.limit.invalidUsd: Enter an amount above zero, like 5.00.
online.limit.needs.number: Continue works once the limit is a whole number, like 200.
online.limit.needs.amount: Continue works once the amount is above zero, like 5.00.
online.limit.hint: Then questions are answered on this computer until the 1st. {settings} shows how many are left, under {onlineAnswers}.
online.limit.changed: Changed from 200. Then questions are answered on this computer until the 1st.
online.limit.noneNow: There is no limit. Nocturne will send every question online until you turn it off.
online.limit.aside.heading: When the limit is reached
online.limit.aside.answers: Questions are answered on this computer, with a plain note on each answer. Nothing stops working.
online.limit.aside.first: On the 1st of the month, online answers start again by themselves.
online.consent.title: Before you turn this on, here is exactly what happens.
online.consent.lead: While this is on, each question and the few lines that answer it leave this computer. Everything else you kept stays here.
online.consent.sent.heading: What is sent, for each question
online.consent.sent.body: Your question, and the few things you kept that answer it, as short sentences. At most 12, each with the day you kept it. For example:
online.consent.goes.heading: Where it goes
online.consent.goes.label: On this computer, Nocturne finds the lines. Its engine sends them straight to {host}, which writes the answer. Back on this computer, Nocturne checks every receipt.
online.consent.goes.finds: Nocturne finds the few lines that answer you
online.consent.goes.checks: Nocturne checks every receipt before you see it
online.consent.goes.body: Nocturne’s engine on this computer sends each question straight to that service, with the details you gave. Nothing passes through Nocturne’s makers: there is nothing in between for them to run.
online.consent.sees.heading: Who can see it
online.consent.sees.body: {host} can see each question, the lines sent with it, when you ask, and this computer’s internet address. What it uses to write answers, {used}, may be made by another company that the service passes questions to.
online.consent.sees.keeps: Nocturne can’t check what the service keeps, for how long, or whether it learns from your questions. Read its privacy page before you turn this on.
online.consent.never.heading: Never sent
online.consent.never.photos: Photos, recordings and documents, including the ones these lines came from
online.consent.never.sensitive: Nocturne leaves out lines that look like health, money or ID details, unless you chose to send them. It can miss some, so keep anything you never want sent marked private.
online.consent.never.rest: Everything else you kept, your pages and your name
online.consent.changes.heading: What changes
online.consent.changes.body: Your questions are answered by {host}, on your account with them, so it may charge for each one. Answers may take a few seconds longer. If it can’t be reached, this computer answers, and says so.
online.consent.mind.heading: Changing your mind
online.consent.mind.limit: At most {limit} questions a month go online; after that, this computer answers until the 1st.
online.consent.mind.money: At most {limit} a month goes to the service; after that, this computer answers until the 1st.
online.consent.mind.none: There is no limit on how many questions go online.
online.consent.mind.rest: Turn it off at any time in {settings} or {privacy}.
online.consent.mind.where: Every answer says where it was written. {seeWhatWasSent} shows the exact words.
online.consent.failed: Nocturne couldn’t save this, so nothing was turned on. Try again.
online.consent.declined: Not turned on. To use this service, check it again from Advanced details.
online.consent.aside.heading: Your choices
online.consent.aside.nothingYet: Nothing has been sent yet, apart from the one test question with nothing you kept.
